text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run precision through the model instead of a response file**

For the required real-model campaign, `--precision-response-file` bypasses inference: the existing CLI sends that file directly to `classifyPrecisionFixture` (`src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:473-489`). Following this instruction would therefore repeat a canned response rather than produce sweep-off/on precision observations under the recorded model and configuration, making the AC9 precision evidence and associated cost figures invalid. Specify the real-model `--quality` invocation without this fixture-only option, or add a distinct output mechanism.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
